The '''E-Wing: Type B''' was a modified version of the base [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighter]] manufactured by [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek Incorporated]]. Due to the initial designs of the E-wing relying on synthetically [[spin-sealed]] [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] to power the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters']] weapon system were found to be underpowered.<ref name="EGVV" /> The gas broke down too quickly, reducing the effective range of the E-wing's weapons.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] were unable to devise a permanent solution to the problem in time as the E-wings were to be deployed in [[Battle of Calamari|combat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Instead, the technicians rigged the laser cannons to accept triple the standard power feed. The increased power brought the weapons up to an acceptable combat range, but the jury-rigging left the fighters vulnerable to a terminal power overload.<ref name="EGVV" />
